UNCERTAINTIES AND POLICIES THAT MATTER
- Pod product page inconsistently gives 106/110 gallons; candidate explicitly leaves water volume unconfirmed. Current warranty policy gives two years for orders on/after Jan 15, 2026; older product prose still says one year. Candidate uses current policy. Standard model-specific cooling minimum is 41F; generic page advertising 39F is not used. Return terms exclude water-contact pods and separately say sale items are excluded: confirm eligibility for a discounted order before purchase. No public affiliate offer verified for Pod.
- Ice Barrel's limited lifetime barrel warranty is explicitly capped at three years; chiller coverage is one year. The power spec only confirms ~115V, 60Hz and 15A MOP. No standard/dedicated outlet facet was inferred. Occupancy is not confirmed. The 30% return fee is retained. Return policy inconsistently mentions delivery date and order date; obtain written deadline confirmation. Main-equipment warranty facet uses the chiller's one year.
- Plunge: base one-year warranty retained; don't guarantee a temporary warranty promotion. Delivery eligibility depends on ZIP/zone; no blanket free in-home-delivery claim. Return fee 25% after shipping; cancellation 5% before shipping.
- Sun Home September 2026 owner's manual v4.0 verifies 28–70F cooling-only setpoint, 150 gallons, 78.7 x 33.5 x 34.2 in, 400lb, dedicated 120V/15A GFCI. It replaces older inconsistent 345lb or clearance copy. The lowest temperature is an equipment spec, never a recommended immersion temperature. Warranty is one year; labor/shipping become customer-paid after 90 days. Returns are unopened/unused only, 25% plus round-trip freight.
- Site-specific electricity/installation costs, availability at checkout, exact shipping totals and actual affiliate earnings remain unknown. Manufacturer-hosted review widgets were not imported or treated as independent evidence.

AFFILIATE OPPORTUNITIES — OWNER NOTES ONLY
Sun Home's public Common Questions page states 5% for saunas/cold plunges and a 35-day cookie. Applying and approval are required; no relationship exists yet. At the listed $13,999, 5% is $699.95 gross hypothetical commission before exclusions, returns, adjustments, tax/shipping basis, and negotiated terms. This is not a revenue forecast.

Ice Barrel publicly points to a ShareASale application at https://icebarrel.com/pages/work-with-us ; percentage, cookie, and accepted partner status are not verified. Do not use third-party affiliate claims as established terms.
